method.synchronization: One pixel read from the actual result; diagnostic reads are excluded from transfer counters.
method.painting: One resampled dab and publication; one or four enabled channels; bounded interactive preview, full document publication.
method.filter: Radius-4 separable Gaussian; baseline scalar CPU versus upgraded RGBA GPU. GPU timing includes its output synchronization.
method.undo: Blender opacity-edit undo transaction plus engine restoration; GPU stroke undo hits are verified separately.
method.memory: Base-level addon textures only, excluding Blender images, mip storage and driver overhead; pooled bytes are global.
method.transfers: Explicit addon GPU uploads/readbacks and allocation/eviction counters. Blender-internal transfers are not observable here.
method.interpretation: Five warm samples are a small local comparison, not a production tail-latency guarantee.

coverage.background_method: Complete 161-script run plus corrected-test reruns and authoring_workflow.
coverage.legacy_reference: 0.12.2 compatibility contract passed, including saved appearance and export settings

tradeoffs: First-use GPU surface preparation increases cold preview setup in most cases; geometry is cached across gestures.
The bounded texture pool can churn at four-channel 4K publication; measured publication is slower there.
Overlapping UVs, graph-resolved dabs and reflected planar dabs retain CPU source replay.
Vulkan/OpenGL driver behavior and performance remain unmeasured.
